wheel_coupling.relation: q6 = -(q7 - q5), equivalently q7 = q5 - q6 (export-zero increments, radians)
wheel_coupling.sign_status: Geometric inference for chosen +X wheel and outward tool axes from external bevel mesh on +X/+tool quadrant; not validated against powered hardware
wheel_coupling.evidence: Equal 24-tooth bevel gears; source design pp14-15: J5 independent, J6 and wheels driven in series
wheel_coupling.urdf_note: No single-joint URDF mimic can express a sum of J5 and J6. Wheel is exported as a continuous visual branch; application must apply this relation or omit wheel animation.

caveats: Output joint coordinates are not motor coordinates: J4 universal shaft is not constant velocity, J6/wheel is coupled.
UWB/limiter chain is omitted from interactive arm because it is a separate coupled mechanism; retained statically in engineer.glb.
Tiny fasteners, bearing internals and motor internals may be simplified/omitted; single CAD motor part remains with its housing.
